ticker_news.title: Warren Buffett Just Loaded Up On This Unstoppable AI Stock
ticker_news.description: Berkshire Hathaway initiated a new position in Alphabet, signaling potential interest in AI technology. The investment was likely made between July and September 2025, when the stock was trading at a lower price, and represents a strategic move by Berkshire's fund managers.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury

QQQ.title: Could This Be One of the Smartest ETFs to Buy Right Now?
QQQ.description: The Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) is highlighted as a strong investment option for long-term investors seeking exposure to tech and AI-driven companies, with a notable 484% total return over the past decade.
QQQ.author: Neil Patel
